$comment: What 'Japan is complete' means. The brief's country content system (sections A-J) is the definition: A geography, B cities, towns and villages, C destinations, D food, E history, F belief, G everyday life, H architecture and art, I music, literature and performance, J language. Chapters carry A and D-J; regions, cities and places carry B and C. scripts/audit-content.ts checks the data against this file, and against the brief's topic lists in lib/content/brief.ts.
$selection: Places chosen by research/countries/japan/place-selection.md (2026-11-13, agreed with the owner): a place gets its own page only if it has a top designation (World Heritage component, National Treasure building, Special Historic Site or Special Place of Scenic Beauty), is the only place for a story the atlas must tell, or is among the places most visitors to the region go to. Viewpoints, bridges, markets and streets inside a bigger place are sections of that place or of the city page. Cities with an empty list carry their folded sights on the city page.

reserve.$comment: First additions if a region gets another page, in order; see place-selection.md.
